learning_objective: 🎯 Learn how to use your voice, expressions, and imagination to turn flat words on a page into living, breathing characters!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Play reading, also known as reader's theater, is like acting with a script right in your hand. You do not need fancy costumes or a huge stage because your voice and facial expressions do all the magical work to tell the story.
Have you ever listened to a boring robot speak? Voice modulation fixes that by adjusting your pitch, volume, and speed to make your words sound exciting, spooky, or absolutely hilarious!

A script is just plain ink on paper until you add your feelings. By changing how you breathe, pause, and stress certain words, you can show the audience if a character is secretly angry, jumping with joy, or feeling super shy.
Before you read a line, ask yourself why the character is saying it. Understanding their hidden thoughts and motivations helps you read the dialogue exactly how they would say it in real life.

fun_activity.title: 🎙️ The Epic Voice Actor Challenge
fun_activity.instructions: Grab your favorite comic book or story and choose a scene with two different characters. Read the dialogue aloud using a squeaky mouse voice for one character and a deep superhero voice for the other!

quick_recap: ⭐ Play reading focuses on bringing a written script to life using just your vocal skills and awesome facial expressions.
⭐ Voice modulation prevents you from sounding like a robot by mixing up your volume, pitch, and talking speed.
⭐ Understanding your character's true feelings and motivations makes your performance much more believable, engaging, and fun.
